page: Microsoft Azure E4s_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ESv3 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8171M processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. Memory capacity is set at 32.0 GB, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage consists of a 66 GB volume, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are included.

Benchmark evaluations place the E4s_v3 in the lower performance tiers. In CPU-bound workloads, the instance scored 1243.29 in stress-ng single-core and 3267.66 in multi-core tests, both falling into the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests also show limitations, with read-only small block cached bandwidth at 150.83 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 18.11 GB/sec, placing memory performance in the bottom 10% to 25% range. Geekbench scores further reflect these constraints, yielding a single-core score of 872.0 and a multi-core score of 1936.0.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E4s_v3 offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio within an older hardware class, making it a candidate for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-speed compute or high memory bandwidth. Tradeoffs include lower processing speeds and restricted memory throughput, as evidenced by the weak performance in database operations and Redis SET operations. This server is best suited for lightweight database hosting, basic caching layers, static web serving, and memory-heavy legacy applications that are not CPU-bound.
description: Microsoft Azure E4s_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the ESv3 family, configured with 4 vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8171M processor running at 2.6 GHz, this x86_64 instance features 2 physical cores with Hyper-Threading and includes 66 GB of local storage with Premium Storage support. Benchmark data indicates modest performance characteristics, with CPU and memory bandwidth scores consistently falling into the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Specifically, the instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 1936.0 and a PassMark memory score of 1739.08. Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core alongside lower compute throughput, the E4s_v3 is best suited for memory-intensive but computationally light workloads, such as basic caching layers, lightweight database hosting, and static web serving.
